description: Eisenberg hydrophobic-moment analysis of CrtB helices from the AlphaFold model
code:
import numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re
seq=("MNNPSLLNHAVETMAVGSKSFATASKLFDAKTRRSVLMLYAWCRHCDDVIDDQTLGFQARQPALQTPEQR"
     "LMQLEMKTRQAYAGSQMHEPAFAAFQEVAMAHDIAPAYAFDHLEGFAMDVREAQYSQLDDTLRYCYHVAG"
     "VVGLMMAQIMGVRDNATLDRACDLGLAFQLTNIARDIVDDAHAGRCYLPASWLEHEGLNKENYAAPENRQ"
     "ALSRIARRLVQEAEPYYLSATAGLAGLPLRSAWAIATAKQVYRKIGVKVEQAGQQAWDQRQSTTTPEKLT"
     "LLLAASGQALTSRMRAHPPRPAHLWQRPL")
print("len",len(seq))
for m in re.finditer(r"D.{3}D", seq):
    print("Asp-rich DxxxD at", m.start()+1, m.group())
# HELIX records in AlphaFold model
hel=[]
for l in open("struct/CrtB_PANAN_AF.pdb"):
    if l.startswith("HELIX"):
        hel.append((int(l[21:25]), int(l[33:37])))
print("\nHELIX records (AlphaFold):", hel)

# Eisenberg consensus hydrophobicity
EIS=dict(A=.62,R=-2.53,N=-.78,D=-.90,C=.29,Q=-.85,E=-.74,G=.48,H=-.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=.64,F=1.19,P=.12,S=-.18,T=-.05,W=.81,Y=.26,V=1.08)
def moment(s, delta=100.0):
    h=np.array([EIS[c] for c in s]); ang=np.deg2rad(delta)*np.arange(len(s))
    return float(np.hypot((h*np.cos(ang)).sum(),(h*np.sin(ang)).sum())/len(s)), float(h.mean())
W=11
muH=np.full(len(seq),np.nan); H=np.full(len(seq),np.nan)
for i in range(len(seq)-W+1):
    m,h=moment(seq[i:i+W]); muH[i+W//2]=m; H[i+W//2]=h

# per-helix values
rows=[]
for s,e in hel:
    sub=seq[s-1:e]
    if len(sub)<7: continue
    m,h=moment(sub)
    rows.append(dict(start=s,end=e,n=len(sub),muH=round(m,3),meanH=round(h,3),seq=sub))
rows=sorted(rows,key=lambda r:-r["muH"])
print("\nPer-helix Eisenberg hydrophobic moment (CrtB AlphaFold helices), sorted:")
for r in rows: print(f"  H{r['start']:3d}-{r['end']:3d} n={r['n']:2d} muH={r['muH']:.3f} <H>={r['meanH']:+.3f}  {r['seq']}")
json.dump(rows,open("struct/_crtB_helices.json","w"),indent=1)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax[0].plot(np.arange(1,len(seq)+1),muH,color="#2a6ebb",lw=1.4,label="hydrophobic moment $\\mu_H$ (11-res window)")
ax[0].plot(np.arange(1,len(seq)+1),H,color="#c4562a",lw=1.2,alpha=.8,label="mean hydrophobicity $<H>$")
for s,e in hel: ax[0].axvspan(s,e,color="grey",alpha=.13)
ax[0].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6); ax[0].set_xlabel("CrtB residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Eisenberg scale")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].set_title("CrtB (P21683): helical amphipathicity profile\n(grey = AlphaFold helices)",fontsize=10)
x=np.array([r["meanH"] for r in rows]); y=np.array([r["muH"] for r in rows])
ax[1].scatter(x,y,s=34,color="#2a6ebb")
for r in rows:
    if r["muH"]>0.35 or r["meanH"]>0.45:
        ax[1].annotate(f"{r['start']}-{r['end']}",(r["meanH"],r["muH"]),fontsize=7,xytext=(3,3),textcoords="offset points")
xx=np.linspace(-1.0,1.2,50); ax[1].plot(xx,0.60-0.5*xx,"k--",lw=.9)
ax[1].text(0.55,0.56,"amphipathic-helix zone",fontsize=8,rotation=-17)
ax[1].set_xlabel("mean hydrophobicity $<H>$"); ax[1].set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment $\\mu_H$")
ax[1].set_title("Eisenberg plot of CrtB helices",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
